iseult:
Shames the tired earth where even longing dies,
Not by the sea that bore Iseult and Helen,
But in a dark green hollow of the hills

Music and dancing he would need, and naturally would choose one of those legends, like our Tristram and Iseult, which are known to every one in outline, so that a great fund of emotion is ready prepared, but can be stressed in a new place by each new poet.

Iseult, Iseult, by the long waterways
Watching the wintry moon, white as a flower,

Francesca, Guinevere,
Deirdre, Iseult, Heloise,
In the fragrant gardens of heaven
ise: Lil gal, Ise watched y from them first days when youall sat right here befo yo door befo th well an sang sometimes in a way that like t broke m heart.
“He called me to His side an said, ‘Git down on your knees beside me, son, Ise gwine t whisper in your ears.’”
Ise carried y with me into th fields, day after day, an after that, an I sho can plow when yo is there, an I can pick cotton.
“‘Ise agwine t whisper in your ears,’ he said, an I replied, ‘Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.’”
Some was fer gettin after him, but th boss held um back an says, “Jes so longs th nigger dies—” An Sam fell down ont his knees an prayed, “O Lord, Ise comin to y,” an he up an jumps int th stream.
